verses.1: Send the rulers of the earth from the mountains of the desert to Mount Betzion.
verses.2: And it shall be like a lost sheep that has been scattered; its daughters will be like those who have gone astray, to Arnon.
verses.3: Please bring me a plan. I will carry out this plan at dawn. Hide yourself among the darkness; do not be discovered.
verses.4: My rejected ones will dwell in you. They will be excluded from the light of life, because they are worthless. They will be destroyed from the earth.
verses.5: And he shall sit upon it in truth, in the temple of David, where he judges and seeks justice.
verses.6: We heard the loud noise of Gion-Moab’s anger. His anger and his actions were not in accordance with what was expected.
verses.7: Therefore, Yeyelil Moav will continue to do this. All of them will continue to act like those who build stone walls. But we are miserable.
verses.8: For the wickedness of their actions, they became like branches that have fallen from a tree. Their cries were heard by those who could hear them. They were left alone, and they crossed the sea.
verses.9: Therefore, I weep. May Gephen help me! My heart is filled with pain and sorrow. It’s because of your departure and your harvest that I suffer so much.
verses.10: And joy and gladness will be gathered from the vineyards. There will be no more destruction or harm in the vineyards. The paths will no longer be blocked by obstacles. I will rest in peace.
verses.11: Therefore, let him be like a lamp that burns brightly, and his heart be like a wall of stone.
verses.12: And it seemed as though he was overcome with joy on the mountain. He went to the holy place to pray, but he couldn’t do so.
verses.13: This is what the LORD said to Moab from then on.
verses.14: And now, the LORD says: In three years, two servants will be hired out. They will be treated with respect and honor, just as Moab was treated in all those places. The rest of the people are too insignificant to be mentioned at all.
